name: Phone Address
definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone address.

PhoneNumber.name: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.|It is recommended to use only numbers and limited punctuation +,-.(.).

FaxNumber.name: Fax Number
FaxNumber.definition: Collection of information that identifies a FAX number, as defined by telecom services.|It is recommended to use only numbers and limited punctuation +,-.(.).

MobileNumber.name: Mobile Number
